Also, I need to know the validity window for this offer. Is the 15% discount valid for 30 days from the date of purchase, or is it tied to the shipping date? Since we’re planning to order several units next week, having this clarity upfront will help us manage our inventory and customer expectations better. Thanks for your help!

The handbook excerpts provided do not contain any information regarding **bulk order policies**, **business account pricing**, or **pre-purchase condition guarantees**.
